name: munmap
description: munmap() removes a mapping in the virtual address space of the calling process that was previously created by mmap(). It unmaps a region starting at the specified address for the given length.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: The starting address of the mapped region to unmap.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the mapped region to unmap, which must be greater than 0.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error (probably to EINVAL)

errors.description: The addr or length parameters are invalid (e.g., they are too large or not aligned on a page boundary).
The process’s maximum number of mappings would have been exceeded, such as when unmapping a region in the middle of an existing mapping.
